_comment: Baseline Turbo-AOT/C wall-clock ratios for the CI perf smoke (benchmarks/run_ci_smoke.sh). Ratios, not absolute ms, because they are far more stable across noisy shared runners. The gate fails only when a measured ratio exceeds baseline * (1 + tolerance_fraction).
_update_procedure: Rebuild release, then run `TURBO_SMOKE_UPDATE_BASELINE=1 bash benchmarks/run_ci_smoke.sh` on a quiet machine (ideally a Linux GitHub runner, since that is what the nightly gate uses). Review the diff — ratios should stay near ~1x C — and commit. Bump only on an intentional, understood codegen change.
_seeding_note: Ratios below are the conservative (max) values observed across several local best-of-5 runs on Darwin arm64, not a single sample — local fib ratios ranged ~0.95-1.09, primes ~0.95-1.07. Seeded high on purpose so the generous +30% gate has realistic headroom and runner jitter never opens a false tracking issue. STRONGLY recommend re-baselining once on a Linux GitHub runner (the nightly platform) via the update procedure above; Cranelift-vs-gcc may differ from Cranelift-vs-Apple-clang.
